summary: D3: Markdown research-evidence rendering. New scripts/automation/dashboard_research_summary.py renders the generated '## 2. Research Evidence & Canonical Identity' section of RESEARCH_DASHBOARD.md (BEGIN/END AUTO:RESEARCH-EVIDENCE markers) covering (A) a research-evidence snapshot, (B) one entry per curated reference-evidence key with canonical display name as the primary label and legacy aliases (H15, D8b, D8) as secondary structured metadata, (C) an F20/R90F10 target-assessment table, (D) goal/dataset readiness from the registries' own status fields, and (E) a safety/evidence legend reusing result_explorer.WARN_TEXT verbatim. Architectural authority rule enforced: the module calls result_explorer.run_query() in-process (no subprocess, no CLI) for every scientific metric and for the experiment_identity block; it reads automation/registry/reference_evidence.yaml ONLY for (key, goal) routing pairs (never metrics/thresholds/aliases) and automation/registry/goals.yaml + datasets.yaml only for their own status/capability fields; it never independently re-matches an alias to a canonical evaluation. F20/R90F10 comparator operators and thresholds are parsed from goals.yaml success_targets[*].rule free text (regex on Rfall/FAR + operator + threshold), never hardcoded/changed; a target counted reached via an inclusive comparator (>=, <=) sitting exactly at its threshold (1e-9 tolerance) is labeled '<target> boundary' instead of 'reached'; a not-fully-reached target renders a per-component breakdown (e.g. 'R90 recall component reached, FAR component not reached') always alongside its evidence_level. Four safe states implemented and tested: matched (full identity attached), identity_unavailable (metrics shown, 'Identity unavailable: <reason>', no fabricated canonical ID), identity_mismatch (metrics shown, 'Identity mismatch -- canonical identity suppressed: <reason>', no canonical ID from the conflicting record), and refused/provenance_mismatch (metrics withheld entirely, REFUSED reason shown) plus an honest missing-reference empty state (no stale metrics retained -- the whole section is rebuilt fresh every render). scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py changed minimally: imports dashboard_research_summary, adds a _research_sources() helper mirroring the Result Explorer CLI's own source wiring, adds r_research_evidence(), and inserts it into render()'s parts list between r_now_next and r_roadmap (filling the pre-existing, never-used '## 2.' numbering gap) -- no other function changed. Real-data smoke render (read-only, real committed registries, no --split, no experiment/evaluation/export/threshold-selection command): the generated section shows H15 (canonical evaluation_id eval_fall_detection_sensefi_ut_har_afac_pgd_eps0p015_frozen_test_v1, canonical run_id run_fall_detection_sensefi_ut_har_afac_optionb_seed42_maxscore_v1, H15 as an unverified legacy alias, TP/FN/FP/TN 41/4/60/395, Rfall 0.911111, FAR 0.131868, frozen-test, target row 'R90 recall component reached, FAR component not reached; frozen-test at eps=0.015') and AFAC (canonical evaluation_id eval_fall_detection_sensefi_ut_har_afac_pgd_eps0p030_test_posthoc_v1, same shared run_id, D8b verified + D8 unverified broader-family as separate structured aliases, TP/FN/FP/TN 36/9/91/364, Rfall 0.8, FAR 0.2, test-post-hoc, target row 'F20 boundary, test-post-hoc') and goal readiness (walking_detection 'dataset-supported but not yet evaluated', gait/future-risk goals 'data needed'). No HTML file created or modified (verified: '.html' absent from dashboard_research_summary.py; git status/diff show no dashboard/ path). Receipt-impact analysis (read-only, before this claim): grepped every existing receipt for scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py; DASH-S3's files_created entry for it carries no sha256 (existence-only check, unaffected by content edits); DASH-S4/DASH-S5/DASH-S6/AUT-APPROVAL-BIND reference it only in files_modified, which verify_receipt() never hash-checks. Empirically re-ran `python scripts/automation/update_dashboard.py --verify` after the code changes: TOOL-REXP, REG-EXPERIMENT-ID, AUT-APPROVAL-BIND, REG-GOALS, REF-EVID, REG-DATASETS, AUT-TSG-impl, ROADMAP-V2, DASH-S8-design, AUT-VPG-design, AUT-GSC-impl all remained at their exact prior display/checks (no drift); no superseding claim was needed for any existing task. Tests: scripts/automation/test_dashboard_research_summary.py (new, 18 tests: D3-1..D3-15 plus D3-5b comparator unit test, D3-13b anti-independent-alias-mapping check, and a real-committed-registry smoke test) -- 18/18 pass. Full regression: scripts/automation/test_result_explorer.py 40/40 pass (unchanged); scripts/automation/test_experiment_identity.py 32/32 pass (unchanged); scripts/automation/validate_experiment_identity.py PASS zero errors (unchanged); scripts/automation/test_approve.py ALL PASS (unchanged); scripts/automation/test_verify.py ALL PASS (unchanged). Dashboard integrity CLEAN; idempotency PASS twice (do_render(write=False) byte-identical, and a second --render introduced no additional git diff). No experiment, training, validation, model-evaluation, export, or threshold-selection command was run; no command contained --split. No historical alias, reference key, protocol ID, or result path was renamed. automation/registry/experiment_identity.yaml, automation/registry/reference_evidence.yaml, automation/artifact_manifest.csv, automation/registry/goals.yaml, automation/registry/datasets.yaml, scripts/automation/result_explorer.py, scripts/automation/test_result_explorer.py, automation/acceptance/result-explorer.yaml, automation/acceptance/experiment-identity.yaml, scripts/automation/validate_experiment_identity.py, scripts/automation/test_experiment_identity.py were NOT modified. dashboard/index.html (DASH-S8) was not started.
